request: Build a memory match card game in a single HTML file. A 4x4 grid of cards is shuffled face-down. Clicking two cards flips them; if they match they stay face-up and the pair counter increments. Track moves, a timer, and show a win message when all pairs are found.

intent.goal: memory match card game in a single HTML file.

planFiles.summary: Memory match game HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in one file
